title: Fabrication and identification of polysulfone/Fe3O4@APTES nanocomposite membranes used in membrane bioreactors for oily wastewater treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,467-480
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00821A, Paper
Maryam Beit Sady, Ferial Nosratinia, Ahmad Khoshgard, Mehdi Ardjmand
In this study, nanocomposite membranes were fabricated and characterized for use in membrane bioreactors (MBRs) to treat oily wastewater.
